kind: integrated theory contracts and prospective cumulative validation overlay

source_contract.delivery_commit: Supply exact final full SHA from the accompanying delivery, not inferred HEAD or af7 preregistration source.
source_contract.latest_main_rule: Fetch and record current main. Preserve original pins. If main advanced/diverged, integrate in a fresh worktree and qualify the actual merged tree. No duplicated cherry-picks, reset or force push.

inheritance.policy: Overlay only; original nodes, dependencies, argv, scientific caps, negative results and retry counters remain authoritative. No candidate-specific retry reset.

coverage.meaning: Planned semantic coverage, not executed passes. Source ancestry proves inclusion, not that later commits preserved behavior.

command_catalog.lock_rule: Serialize native builds/tests/benchmarks/profiles. run_local.py already owns this lock; do not wrap it in the same outer flock.
command_catalog.executor: Reuse production_solver_closure_20261027/run_local.py and record_command.py. Invoke argv arrays without shell interpolation, retain nonzero exit/raw logs, and record reached/ignored tests.

result_contract.performance_rule: Same physical problem/caps/checkpoints/permissions and strongest eligible comparator; paired isolated blocks, executable/host/profile hashes, all setup/certification/failed work. Existing project authority and holdout thresholds are unchanged.

release_rule: Qualification is scoped to explicitly implemented/enabled routes and named clients. Pending optional N candidates are not claimed active. Every required gate for an advertised route must pass; unresolved mandatory Q/environment failures remain blockers.
